name: Nanjou Sakura
source:
Sakura is a young woman who recently started teaching and is also in charge of managing the dormitory. She is a long-standing acquaintance of the grandfather because she was one of his student when she was a university student and that he was still working in his profession. Beautiful, delicate, charming, she is very popular with the students and with the other teachers. She takes her role as an educator very seriously and seeks to help all her students.

When [url=/c82292]Kanata[/url] arrives in the dormitory, she puts him at ease right away, reassuring him about the very large female presence in the house and making him understand that if he needs to confide in her or to talk about his problems, that she would be listening and always ready to help him. 

However, even if Kanata finds that she has a lot of charisma, Sakura is not really used to boys and she doesn't really know how to advise them but she still does her best.
